evidence: XPS analysis confirmed the growth of highly pure ZnO films without carbon and nitrogen impurities, while XRD analysis revealed the deposition of reasonably crystalline films. The TGA curves for complexes 1–4 indicated that <10% nonvolatile residues were present, indicating their possible vaporization in ALD. The thermal analysis showed that the newly synthesized complexes are sufficiently thermally stable and volatile for use in the ALD process. The 1H NMR spectra of complexes 1–4 were observed using benzene-d6 as the solvent and reference at room temperature. FT-IR spectra were obtained using a Nicolet Nexus FT-IR spectrophotometer. The plane view morphology of the ZnO film deposited on SiO2 substrates was observed using FE-SEM. UV-visible spectroscopy was used to determine the optical properties of the prepared ZnO film. The film thickness was measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE, Horiba Jobin Yvon UVISEL).
